title: スプリングSの後に・止まらず先へ

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Thanks, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Thanks, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I still made lots of mistakes. I have to work harder!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon! Miss Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …May I help you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: We got to see a bit of the Auburn Rocket back there!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Everyone is looking forward to seeing the glorious moment when you become the Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Your support is appreciated. Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ah, w-wait! Just one question! Please, let me ask just one question!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon… Do you have any rivals?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rivals?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My data determines that such things are unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: If I am first, then my opponents are irrelevant factors.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Wow.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: She's strong and confident. You can tell she walks her own path…
choice_data_list: Looks like you've got your work cut out for you.
Looks like you've got your work cut out for you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon… is only going to get further and further ahead. If I want to catch up to her… then I can't stop training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …But I will catch up to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown is composed of three Classic races—the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The upcoming Satsuki Sho is a 2000-meter turf race. As a stayer, Rice Shower needs a bit more distance to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To have our first real chance at beating Mihono Bourbon…
choice_data_list: We should take on the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Okay, got it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's where I'll catch up to Bourbon…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: For sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Rice Shower and I resolve to begin preparations for the Japanese Derby.
